## Invariants → checks — 61 sections in `.ai-context/invariants.md`

| invariant (line) | check (smoke.mjs line) |
|---|---|
| The library renders, and it renders quietly (101) | __vs is present and the library rendered (285); the page loads with no console errors (279) |
| The seven default shelves are the seven default shelves (110) | — no check named in the section |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (117) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (298) |
| Every note has at least one address (130) | every note reachable from the vault is on at least one shelf (311) |
| A book opens on its oldest note (138) | date contents default to oldest and saved newest settings remain readable (377) |
| A note with no date of its own (147) | a note with no date of its own takes the earliest stamp the file has (395) |
| Undated is a book, not a guess (161) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (324) |
| The ISO week keeps its week-year (176) | an ISO week keeps its week-year across a January boundary (432) |
| The Encyclopedia opens with 0-9 (185) | the Encyclopedia opens with a 0-9 volume, not ten one-note books (448) |
